Information about the bundled engine

Source: R/info.R
zuslothdb_info.Rd

Reports which engine source the package was built from: a tagged release of libzugodb, the package's engine, which descends from SlothDB.

Usage

zuslothdb_info()

Value

A list with elements engine ("libzugodb"), repository, commit and tag (libzugodb's repository, the full commit hash and its release tag), origin and origin_commit (SlothDB and the commit libzugodb descends from), describe (the last SlothDB release before it, as "v0.2.7+") and threads (the engine's thread cap, an integer).

Examples

info <- zuslothdb_info()
info$commit
#> [1] "d3ec8c5ff1818c5079ecac0185514656fb715e66"
info$tag
#> [1] "v0.1.1"
